variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Dried pork meat (28%), tapioca, potatoes, hydrolysed salmon protein, animal fat (chicken oil) , animal fat (tallow) , pea fibre, fish oil (salmon oil)*, dried peas, dried fish (anchovies 4%), minerals, xylo-oligosaccharides (XOS 0.4%), pineapple, dried edible chestnut (0.01%), products and by-products derived from the processing of fresh fruits and vegetables (melon juice concentrate – Cucumis melo cantalupensis – source of superoxide dismutase 0.005%), milk protein powder. *Refined to 99.6%, preserved with natural antioxidants. **Highly digestible ingredients.

Analytical constituents: Crude protein 32%, crude fibre 5%, crude fat 20%, crude ash 6.9%, sodium 0.4%, potassium 1.2%, chlorides 0.8%.

Additives: Nutritional additives: Vitamin A (retinyl acetate) 25,000 IU, vitamin D3 1,500 IU, selenium (sodium selenate 0.27 mg) 0.12 mg, manganese (manganese sulphate monohydrate 77 mg) 25 mg, copper (copper(II) sulphate pentahydrate 39 mg) 10 mg, iron (iron(II) sulphate monohydrate 249 mg) 82 mg, iodine (anhydrous calcium iodate 7.3 mg) 4.8 mg, L-carnitine 100 mg, taurine 2,500 mg. Technological additives: Tocopherol extracts from vegetable oils.
variants.feeding_instructions: FEEDING INSTRUCTIONS: It is recommended to consult a veterinarian before use. Recommended duration of use: up to 12 weeks. Recommended daily feeding amounts in grams are provided in the table; they should be divided into two meals. The animal should have constant access to fresh, clean water. This product is intended exclusively for pets and is not suitable for human consumption.
